decisions.reason: As a newly launched pharmaceutical product with its own webpage, it reflects clear investment and visible commitment, so management is likely to continue and attribute any weak early performance to launch-stage factors.
Even as a generic, the hard capsule sits within the firm’s core pharmaceutical business and has its own page, which makes management inclined to justify the recent launch by keeping it on the market.
This combination antihypertensive is a core prescription-type product with dedicated website presentation, so recent investment and public positioning make withdrawal within a year unlikely.

The dietary supplement appears less central and was only mentioned rather than fully featured, but its very recent launch still gives management reasons to persist for now rather than abandon it immediately.
